verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing's API lets ops create cardholders and physical cards, customize card art/logo, and Stripe handles printing/shipping/manufacturing relationship (docs-2, docs-8), with replacement cards for lost/damaged/stolen (docs-7/20). However, evidence lacks specifics on bulk ordering workflows, choice of shipping methods/speeds, and shipment tracking details, and community feedback notes the product is invitation-only/API-first with limited built-in UX for such operational tasks (comm-5, comm-7). missing for 10: explicit bulk-order API/workflow documentation, shipping method selection and tracking number retrieval, and independent confirmation of at-scale physical card fulfillment.
